findings.title: Denial cache key omits identity type and uses unnormalized user identifier, causing cross-identity collisions
findings.body: `userPermDenialCacheKey` is built in `Check` from `checkReq.UserUID` (the raw identifier parsed from `req.Subject`) without including `checkReq.IdentityType` or normalizing `UserUID` via `GetUserIdentifiers` (unlike `permCache`, which uses `userIdentifiers.UID`). Because `validateSubject` accepts `user`, `service-account`, `anonymous`, and `render` subjects, two different principals with the same identifier (for example `anonymous:0` vs `render:0`, or `user:1` vs `service-account:1`, or a user referenced by numeric ID `1` in one call and UID `u1` in another) share or split the same denial cache key `<ns>.perm_<id>_<action>_<name>_<parent>`. An unprivileged `anonymous:0` check that is denied will populate `permDenialCache` and cause subsequent `render:0` checks for the same resource to be denied for up to `shortCacheTTL`, and a denial recorded under a user's numeric ID will be bypassed when the same user is checked by UID.

findings.title: Stale folder tree cache causes false denial and caches the denial when a newly created subfolder is checked
findings.body: When `Check` misses `permCache` (or the cached permissions do not grant access) and falls back to `getIdentityPermissions`, the subsequent `s.checkPermission(ctx, permissions, checkReq)` still evaluates inherited folder permissions against `s.buildFolderTree`, which returns the cached `folderCache` entry without refreshing it. If a user creates a subfolder under a folder they have permissions on (where permissions are inherited from the parent folder rather than granted directly on the new subfolder) and immediately accesses the new subfolder or a dashboard inside it, `tree.Ancestors(req.ParentFolder)` will not find the newly created folder in the cached tree, `checkPermission` will return `false`, and line 154 will cache that false result in `permDenialCache` for 30 seconds.

findings.title: Denial cache test sets `dashboards:uid:dash1` to `false` instead of `true` in `permCache`
findings.body: In `TestService_CacheCheck` ("Should deny on explicit cache deny entry"), the comment states "Allow access to the dashboard to prove this is not checked", but line 982 sets `map[string]bool{"dashboards:uid:dash1": false}`. Even if `permDenialCache` were bypassed and `permCache` were consulted, `checkPermission` would still return `false` (and with an empty `fakeStore`, the DB fallback would also return `false`), so the test would pass even if `permDenialCache` did nothing. The map value should be `true`.
